detail.text:
Marketing and tracking consent
Marketing Emails
Receive marketing communications and targeted advertising from us from time to time.
Email Open Tracking
We and our service providers use open tracking pixels in our marketing and transactional emails to see if you have opened them and to gather device information. This helps us personalize content, adjust how often we message you, and choose the best channel to reach you.

You can withdraw your consent at any time using the unsubscribe link in the footer of our emails.

cases.Steps: Load at 320px wide.
cases.Expected result: No horizontal scrolling and no clipped or overlapping copy; the long tracking description wraps.
cases.Source of truth / notes: WCAG 2.2 AA 1.4.10. overflow-wrap: anywhere is set on the disclosure only.

cases.Steps: Measure each checkbox hit area at 390x844.
cases.Expected result: Each target is at least 24x24 CSS px, or has sufficient spacing.
cases.Source of truth / notes: WCAG 2.2 AA 2.5.8.

cases.Test case: Validation errors are announced
cases.Steps: Submit with the email empty using a screen reader.
cases.Expected result: The error is announced and associated with the field; aria-invalid is set and the message precedes other descriptions in aria-describedby.
cases.Source of truth / notes: MultiInputField orders the validation message id ahead of the description id.

observations.note: aria-invalid and associated error text inspected; actual screen-reader announcement is untested

cases.Test case: No duplicate ids with two versions on the page
cases.Preconditions: An A/B test rendering the consent block twice
cases.Steps: Run axe over the whole page.
cases.Expected result: No duplicate-id violations; each instance has its own input, legend and disclosure ids.

observations.note: Consent input, legend, disclosure IDs and group names are unique across two simultaneous embedded instances. Whole-page inspection finds duplicate email and rich-text IDs outside consent. The exact authored A/B-version scenario remains untested.

cases.Test case: Email on the consent block's step - no alert
cases.Preconditions: Consent block and a visible email input on the same step, step reachable
cases.Steps: Run form alert validation.
cases.Expected result: No placement alert is emitted.

observations.note: Backend/API validation and publishing are outside this no-write browser run. No API publish was attempted.

cases.Test case: Email only on an earlier step - blocking alert
cases.Preconditions: Consent block on step 2, email on step 1, step 2 reachable
cases.Steps: Run form alert validation.
cases.Expected result: marketingTrackingConsentMissingEmailOnSameStep, blocking = true, entity_type = block, entity_id = the consent block.

observations.note: Backend/API validation and publishing are outside this no-write browser run. No API publish was attempted.

cases.Test case: Phone on the same step does not satisfy the rule
cases.Preconditions: Consent block and a phone input on the same step, no email
cases.Steps: Run form alert validation.
cases.Expected result: The alert is still raised; only an email input satisfies it.
cases.Source of truth / notes: FormIndex registers the consent block as a generic input, never as email_input.

observations.note: Backend/API validation and publishing are outside this no-write browser run. No API publish was attempted.

cases.Test case: Device coverage must be complete
cases.Preconditions: Consent block visible on both devices; email input desktop-only
cases.Steps: Run form alert validation.
cases.Expected result: Alert raised - a mobile visitor would be stranded.
cases.Source of truth / notes: Rule is per targeted device, intersected with the block's display devices.

observations.note: Backend/API validation and publishing are outside this no-write browser run. No API publish was attempted.

cases.Test case: Matching single-device visibility is fine
cases.Preconditions: Consent block desktop-only and email desktop-only; likewise mobile-only
cases.Steps: Run form alert validation.
cases.Expected result: No alert in either case.

observations.note: Backend/API validation and publishing are outside this no-write browser run. No API publish was attempted.

cases.Test case: Unreachable step is not flagged
cases.Preconditions: Consent block on a step nothing transitions to
cases.Steps: Run form alert validation.
cases.Expected result: No alert - an unreachable step strands nobody, and dead content must not become a publish blocker.
cases.Source of truth / notes: Unreachable-step alerts are themselves non-blocking.

observations.note: Backend/API validation and publishing are outside this no-write browser run. No API publish was attempted.

cases.Test case: Each offending block gets its own alert
cases.Preconditions: Two invalid consent blocks on the same step
cases.Steps: Run form alert validation.
cases.Expected result: Two alerts, one per block, each carrying its own entity_id.

observations.note: Backend/API validation and publishing are outside this no-write browser run. No API publish was attempted.

cases.Test case: Public publish API rejects invalid placement
cases.Preconditions: A form persisted via the API with the consent block on a step with no email
cases.Steps: POST /api/form-publish-jobs/ for that form.
cases.Expected result: 400 with error code marketingTrackingConsentMissingEmailOnSameStep and the encoded explanation as detail; publish_form is never invoked.
cases.Source of truth / notes: The JSON:API error carries type and explanation only - no block identity.

observations.note: Backend/API validation and publishing are outside this no-write browser run. No API publish was attempted.

cases.Test case: Valid placement publishes
cases.Preconditions: The same form with the email moved onto the consent block's step
cases.Steps: POST /api/form-publish-jobs/ for that form.
cases.Expected result: 202 Accepted and publish_form is invoked.
cases.Source of truth / notes: Control for BE-08: the two forms differ only in which step the email sits on.

observations.note: Backend/API validation and publishing are outside this no-write browser run. No API publish was attempted.

cases.Test case: Editor alert payload matches the released contract
cases.Steps: GET/POST the editor form-alerts endpoint.
cases.Expected result: type = marketingTrackingConsentMissingEmailOnSameStep, blocking = true, dismissed = false, entity_type = block, entity_id = the block, explanation = the k-repo copy.
cases.Source of truth / notes: Fender's alert card keys off that exact type string.

observations.note: Backend/API validation and publishing are outside this no-write browser run. No API publish was attempted.

cases.Test case: Dismissed or non-blocking alerts do not block publish
cases.Steps: Attempt to publish.
cases.Expected result: Publish proceeds; only live blocking alerts stop it.

observations.note: Backend/API validation and publishing are outside this no-write browser run. No API publish was attempted.

cases.Test case: A retired stored model does not break the transformer
cases.Preconditions: A form whose stored model is SINGLE_COMBINED_CONSENT
cases.Steps: Load the form through the encoded transformation.
cases.Expected result: No EncodedFormTransformationError; the form still loads and alerts still run.
cases.Source of truth / notes: ACTION: clear the consent block from the two internal test accounts still carrying this shape. A swallowed transformation error disables ALL alerts for the form.

observations.note: Backend/API validation and publishing are outside this no-write browser run. No API publish was attempted.

run.scope: Controlled local renderer; real Fender code and freshly captured Uk2K8Q. Bootstrap manifest and response fixtures overridden. Every non-read network request is aborted before dispatch. No live submission or persistence claims.
